about_the_game:
"The Hilarious Three Kingdoms 2" is a strategy war chess game set against the backdrop of the chaotic Three Kingdoms era. Here, you are no longer just a spectator of history, but a lord on the battlefield, recruiting famous generals and training elite troops to write your own legend on the chessboard!

Your choice will be history! Will you follow Cao Cao's ambition, practice Liu Bei's benevolence, protect Sun Quan's Jiangdong, or join forces with the likes of Lu Bu and Dong Zhuo to stir up the world?

The game offers multiple independent main storylines. Each route features unique plots, levels and character alliances, providing completely different epic experiences.

Your army, crafted by you! Each character can choose from multiple advanced troop types for development, such as:

Should the warrior be transformed into a stalwart defender like a wall of copper and iron, or become a lethal assassin with a single strike?

Should the archers be transformed into the rain of arrows crossbowmen or become the one-shot kill sharpshooters?

Every time you choose to change your profession, it will reshape the battlefield. There is no "strongest" type of soldier; only the perfect combination that best suits your tactical system.

The heroic style of famous generals, one man against a thousand! Each legendary warrior possesses a unique ultimate skill.

In addition to the general skills for each troop type, every general has a unique ultimate move: at critical moments, releasing the general's exclusive ultimate skill can turn the tide of battle!

Witness Guan Yu's thunderous slash, feel Zhou Yu's conflagration, or experience Zhang Liao's fear-inducing surprise attack. Each ultimate move is the highest tribute to the legendary careers of these famous generals.

A craftsman who wants to do his job well must first sharpen his tools. The game features a vast equipment system, ranging from ordinary white weapons to legendary divine artifacts.

You can obtain them through battles, exploration and achievements. You can also forge and upgrade your beloved weapons to enhance their attributes and even unlock hidden special effects, making your favorite weapons even more powerful.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Pentium Dual Core级以上
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce FX5600级/ATI Radeon9600以上 (支持Shader 2.0以上的显卡)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 可互换声卡
  • Additional Notes: WINDOWS XP以下不能运行（含XP)
